heading: Bigg Boss 20 Contestants, Premiere Episode LIVE Updates: Jay Bhanushali sends love to Mahhi Vij, says ‘the don is in the house’
paragraphs: Bigg Boss Season 20 Contestants, Premiere Episode Live Updates: The wait is finally over as Bigg Boss 20 had its premiere on September 6. Salman Khan returned as the host for the milestone 20th season and welcomed 16 new contestants.

The Bigg Boss 20 house brings together a diverse mix of celebrities, actors, models, social media personalities, and public figures. The contestants who have entered the Bigg Boss 20 house include M C Mary Kom, Aamrapali Dubey, Uditi Singh, Arishfa Khan, Aman Gandhi, Qazi Ahmad Tauqeer, Harsh Machare aka Yung DSA, Kushal Tanwar aka Gullu, Love Gill, Rohed Khan, Isha Rikhi, Mahhi Vij, Asif Khan, Rhiti Tiwari, Kanika Mann and Tanmay Singh aka Scoutop.
With Bigg Boss 20 promising a new theme, a fresh house and several twists, the contestant lineup is likely to be one of the biggest talking points once the doors officially open.

This Bigg Boss Hindi season’s elaborate set has already become a talking point. Built around the theme ‘Vardaan’, the new Bigg Boss house promises to be unlike its previous editions, combining a minimalist design with quirky, whimsical and slightly unsettling elements.

For the first time in 19 years, designer Omung Kumar has handed over the responsibility of creating the Bigg Boss house to Varsha Jain, who has previously designed houses for the South Indian versions of the reality show. Spread across 10,000 square feet and equipped with 104 cameras, the house has been designed around the idea of duality, leaving several spaces open to interpretation.

Bigg Boss Season 20 will air on Colors TV and stream on JioHotstar. Adding to the excitement, the franchise’s four South Indian editions, Bigg Boss Tamil, Bigg Boss Telugu, Bigg Boss Kannada and Bigg Boss Malayalam, will also kick off on the same day.

Sana Makbul has added fuel to the buzz around Mahhi Vij with a cryptic social media post following her entry in the Bigg Boss 20 house. Sana hinted that she knows the contestant’s “true colours” and suggested that viewers will soon see them for themselves. While fans are connecting the dots to Mahhi, Sana has not directly named her in the post. Sana wrote, “I know her true colours, the world will know them now,” and later added, “You guys know her name,” further intensifying the speculation among viewers.

Bigg Boss 13 runner-up Asim Riaz seemingly took a dig at the ongoing Bigg Boss 20 season with a cryptic X post that read, “Another Flop Season Loading.” The post quickly sparked reactions online, with several users trolling Asim and hitting back at his remark. A user wrote, "Every season flop bolna bhi ek routine ban gaya hai... difference bas itna hai ki Bigg Boss har saal trend karta hai, aur tumhare predictions har saal flop hote hain."
Amid the backlash, Asim soon deleted the post.

As ScoutOp entered Bigg Boss 20, Salman asked about how much he earns from playing esports. Salman asked him, “Kitna aata hai (How much do you earn)?” Tanmay answered the question in Salman's ear. The actor was surprised and asked again, “Mahine ka Rs. 30 lakh?” Tanmay confirmed that he earns around Rs. 30 lakh every month through esports.

Mahhi Vij got a sweet message via ex-husband and actor Jay Bhanushali's Instagram Story, who cheered her as she entered the Bigg Boss 20 house. Jay wrote, “The Don is in the house. Mahhi, all the best, kill it,” while also lovingly referring to her as Tara’s mumma.

In a clip from inside the Bigg Boss 20 house, Mahhi Vij was seen telling Isha Rikhi how cleverly she had managed to get the other contestants to take up the cooking responsibilities. As Mahhi spoke about her strategy, M C Mary Kom, Aamrapali Dubey, Love Gill and Uditi Singh were seen in the kitchen, busy with the household work.
Bigg Boss 13 runner-up Asim Riaz has seemingly taken a swipe at the ongoing Bigg Boss 20 season. On Monday, September 7, he shared a cryptic post on X that simply read, “Another Flop Season Loading.”
With Bigg Boss 20 now underway, the contestants are eagerly waiting for the first set of tasks and the division of daily house duties.

Qazi Touqeer is already making an impression on Bigg Boss 20, and viewers are wondering what kind of journey he will have inside the house. The Fame Gurukul winner, who shot to fame in 2005 and became a popular singing sensation, has the personality and entertainment potential to either emerge as one of the season’s biggest entertainers or end up being the house’s comic relief.

Manoj Tiwari's daughter Rhiti Tiwari is winning hearts inside the Bigg Boss 20 house with her singing as she performed one of her songs for her fellow contestants. She shared her dream of becoming one of India’s famous rockstars and taking her music to a global audience. Her performance left Gullu aka Kushal Tanwar and Rohed Khan impressed, with the two appreciating her musical talent.

Gullu, Kanika Mann and Love Gill were seen in a candid conversation about their work, the projects they have been part of, and their experiences of featuring in music videos. During the chat, Gullu had everyone laughing when he revealed that he had dropped out of college, pursued hotel management, and once dreamed of becoming a truck driver in Canada and Australia but his visa was rejected. He also shared that he worked in a mall for 'half an hour' as he did not like the job.

Bigg Boss 20 contestant and Panchayat actor Aasif Khan opened up about his growing popularity and the love he receives from fans. In live footage from the Bigg Boss house, he was heard sharing about his stardom in a conversation with Bhojpuri actor Amrapali Dubey. he shared how he enjoys a massive fan following and how fans often recognise him wherever he goes, reflecting the growing popularity he has earned through his work in films and OTT shows.

Bigg Boss 20 contestant Kanika Mann is ready to step out of the characters audiences have seen her play on screen and reveal her real personality inside the reality show. Sharing an emotional message with fans, she said, “You have seen me in so many characters, sometimes as a daughter-in-law, sometimes as a daughter. Trust me, I genuinely feel that you have given so much love to every character of mine. So thank you so much for that. And hence, I felt that it’s time for you to meet the real Kanika behind all these characters.” Explaining her decision to enter the show, Kanika added, “I want you to know who I am. Without any script, without any character, without any retakes. But the real me — my personality, my mistakes, my feelings, my craziness, my fun, everything, my truth.” She further questioned whether fans would love the real Kanika as much as they loved her onscreen characters and asked for their support throughout her journey. Promising that she has bigger plans than simply surviving inside the house, Kanika concluded, “I am not coming to this house just to stay. I am coming here to be remembered. So I need your love. Do support me. Do vote for me whenever it’s needed. The trophy is coming home.”

In a live update on the JioHotstar, Bigg Boss 20 contestants Love Gill, Aasif Khan, MC Mary Kom and Aamrapali Dubey were seen preparing breakfast together in the kitchen. The housemates appeared to be settling into their new surroundings and making connections in the Bigg Boss house.

Actor Aasif Khan, known for his roles in web shows such as Paatal Lok, Panchayat and Jamtara, shared an emotional message for his fans ahead of entering the Bigg Boss 20 house. Reflecting on his journey from a small town, he said, “I am not here to ask you for anything. I am not here to make any request. I just want to say a thank you that has been due for many years to my entire audience, my entire public.” Aasif recalled starting out with tiny roles and credited his fans for helping him reach where he is today, saying, “You were the ones who, when I was standing in the back rows, held my finger and brought me forward.” Calling his Bigg Boss entry a result of their love, he added, “Today, I am going to become a part of that show because of you, because of your love.” Aasif also made it clear that winning the trophy is not his ultimate aim, saying, “Trophy winning is not my goal. My goal has always been to win the hearts of my audience.” He ended by asking fans to forgive him if he makes any mistakes during his journey and thanked them for helping him reach this milestone.

Bigg Boss 20 contestant Mahhi Vij has revealed that the show’s team compared her personality and presence with former winner Gauahar Khan. Mahhi said the comparison came as a compliment, given Gauahar’s strong and memorable stint on the reality show. She also opened up about her decision to enter the Salman Khan-hosted show and revealed how her ex-husband Jay Bhanushali and their daughter Tara reacted to her participation. Mahhi said their support has been important to her as she embarks on this new journey inside the Bigg Boss house. READ MORE

The first day inside the Bigg Boss 20 house began on a high-energy note as the contestants woke up to the peppy Bollywood track ‘Dil Dance Maare Re’ from Tashan. The song set the mood for the housemates as they got ready to begin their journey. Love Gill jumped out of her bed dancing on the song.

Bigg Boss 20 contestant Isha Rikhi got emotional while opening up about her recent separation from rapper Badshah during the show’s grand premiere. Isha spoke about how the experience affected her and said she wanted to step out of the shadow of her past relationship and create an identity of her own. Salman Khan consoled her and encouraged her to focus on the present rather than dwell on the past. He told Isha, “Personal matters should be personal only. Move on, Isha, because the other person has moved on a long time ago. So nobody can hurt you emotionally now.” Salman also urged her to concentrate on her Bigg Boss journey and her competitors, reminding her that she should not allow her past to affect her emotionally. READ MORE

Hip-hop artist Yung DSA, who hails from Pune and rose to fame after one of his songs went viral in 2024, is all set to bring his raw energy and culture to the Bigg Boss 20 house. In a video message, he said, "I have come to Bigg Boss 20 and I know even after this, you guys are going to give me a lot of love and support.” Talking about what his participation means to him, he added, “This is for community, this is for hip-hop, this is for music. We are representing real shit, man.” Yung DSA urged fans to watch the show with their families and said he has entered the reality show to represent his culture and slang while showing people “how you rise from zero, why you do it, what you do it for and how far you go after making it.” He concluded with his signature enthusiasm, “Let's go gang, Paddhat Cheer. Keep loving me like this. Love you all guys. Bigg Boss, peace. Peace is not going to stay in the house.”

Esports player and content creator Tanmay Singh aka Scout, who has 4.4 million followers, shared an emotional video message ahead of entering the Bigg Boss 20 house. Talking about his decision to participate in the reality show, he said, “Hey, how are you? This conversation is a little awkward. I mean, I am used to talking to you guys. But this is a decision I never thought I would take, but yeah, we have taken it.” Tanmay explained that Bigg Boss is a different platform and an opportunity to prove that gaming can be a viable career, saying, “National television is where I think I have to prove a point that gaming is something that you can make a career out of.” He added that viewers will get to see the familiar version of Scout and asked fans for their love and support. Tanmay further said, “We need to prove the point that we gamers are not behind other people. I know people put us up and down, but yeah, we are not behind. We have to show this to people.” He also hoped his journey could change how parents view gaming as a career, adding, “Maybe after this, our parents who don't allow us to play games might allow us.”

Beauty and fashion influencer Arishfa Khan, one of the contestants on Salman Khan’s Bigg Boss 20, shared an emotional video message ahead of entering the reality show. With an Instagram following of 29.1 million, Arishfa said, “Hi guys, this is my last video. I think when this video comes out, I will already be inside the Bigg Boss house. I am very excited, very nervous and emotional because this is the first time I am staying away from my mamma and my family.” Calling the opportunity and journey special, she promised to give her best and added, “I am not scared of anything because I know my Arushi fans and all my fans, whom I call my family, are with me and will continue to support me.” She further asked her fans for their love and support, saying she wants to remain her real self inside the house. Arishfa concluded on a confident note, “I am going to give my best and make all of you feel very proud. Inshallah, I will come back after winning. I am enough on my own.”

Winner of Roadies, Spiltsvilla 20, and Maa Hai Na, reality show star Kushal Tanwar aka Gullu, recalling the support he received in his previous shows, Gullu said in his video message to fans, “Whatever shows I have done before, you made them successful. You made me win. You helped me in every way. I gave it my all. This time, I am going to put three times the effort and energy into this.” He further promised fans an entertaining journey, saying, “I am going to have so much fun there. I won't say much right now; you will see it yourself.” Gullu also acknowledged that he could face opposition inside the house, saying, “I know people will be scared of me. They will deliberately vote me out, try to eliminate me and gang up against me. But that doesn't matter to me, and it shouldn't matter to you either. I will jump into this with all your support.” He concluded with an emotional appeal to his fans: “Without your support, I will be absolutely zero here. So please vote for me, support me and make me win Bigg Boss, because this is not just my victory, it is all of our victory. And please, guys, vote for me so that I can win.”

Kushal Tanwar aka Gullu shared a video message on Instagram, announcing his entry into the Bigg Boss 20 house and seeking fans’ love, support and votes. Announcing his entry into the Bigg Boss 20 house, he said, “So guys, I am your own and dear Gullu. I was feeling quite shy making a video like this. I had never tried this before, but it is a very happy moment that I am finally going to Bigg Boss, and I had thought about this a lot.”

Talking about his long-cherished dream of entering the reality show, he added, “I had a lot of dreams. I had started my journey a long time ago with the thought that someday I would reach here. Until now, I had only watched people go to Bigg Boss. But for the first time, I have got the opportunity to go inside the Bigg Boss house myself, so I need a lot of your support and votes.”

Bigg Boss 20 contestant Mahhi Vij has received a warm show of support from actor Riddhi Dogra. Sharing a post on her Instagram Story, Riddhi wrote, “The girl always next to my heart. My Nakusha.... Wish you all the best. May this journey be everything you want it to be,” while tagging Mahhi. Industry friends Ankita Lokhande and Arti Singh also showed support for their friends Mahhi via social media.

Actor and politician Manoj Tiwari's daughter and now a Bigg Boss 20 contestant Rhiti Tiwari is all set to bring her rockstar energy to the reality show. Announcing her entry, Rhiti shared via social media, “It’s time now!! No pauses, no breaks, the music doesn’t stop, it just moves inside. Stepping into the Bigg Boss 20 house to shake things up. Need all your love and support. Lesss go get the trophy now!" Fans can watch their favourite Rockstar Rhiti Tiwari every day at 9 pm on JioHotstar and 10:30 pm on Colors TV.

The Bigg Boss 20 premiere episode has concluded, with the show now following an OTT-first approach, streaming daily at 9:00 pm on JioHotstar, while viewers can watch it on Colors TV at 10:30 pm, Monday to Sunday. As a teaser of what is in store, the premiere showed Mahhi Vij trying to get a few contestants to help her with household chores, including assisting her with clothes and making tea.

Bigg Boss 20 has introduced a major “Extra Jeevan Daan” twist, giving eliminated contestants an unexpected second chance inside the house. Bigg Boss announced that eviction will not necessarily mean an immediate exit, as contestants who are eliminated will continue to remain inside the Bigg Boss premises under the special “Vardaan of Extra Jeevan Daan”. Built around the season’s “Tathas-Two” theme of duality and two chances.

Salman Khan shared that Mahhi Vij was approached for the show multiple times, but she said no every time. She shared that her three children- a biological daughter named Tara and two foster children named Khushi and Rajveer, asked her to join the show this time. Tara was there to cheer Mahhi as she entered the show.
Popular TV actor Mahhi Vij, who made her comeback recently with Seher Hone Ko Hai, is now a part of the Bigg Boss house. Mahhi was also in the news for her divorce from Jay Bhanushali.

Manoj Tiwari’s daughter Rhiti Tiwari has entered the Bigg Boss 20 house as a contestant. During her grand entry, Salman Khan revealed that Manoj, who is an actor and politician, has put his national commitments on hold to take on the role of a supportive father for his daughter. Manoj made a special appearance to drop Rhiti off, while Salman welcomed her with his trademark humour. The promo also revisited Manoj’s memorable stint on Bigg Boss 4, with Salman offering Rhiti some advice about handling arguments inside the house and jokingly telling her, “Don’t fight over eggs.” She is a singer and a composer.

Actor and model Uditi Singh enters the Bigg Boss 20 house. During her interaction with Salman, the superstar addressed her as “Kareena Kapoor”, revealing that many people often mistake her for the Bollywood actor because of her resemblance. Uditi also spoke about her earlier work and revealed that she had worked in a song with Himesh Reshammiya. She is also known for her past relationship with actor Karan Wahi.

Winner of Roadies, Spiltsvilla 20, and Maa Hai Na, reality show star Kushal Tanwar aka Gullu is here to join the Salman Khan-hosted show. Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Thi fame Aman Gandhi is also in the house.

Beauty and fashion influencer Arishfa Khan might be one of the contestants of Salman Khan’s Bigg Boss 20. She comes with an Instagram following of 29.1 million. She shared that she has 10 cats, and the cats also have 1 lakh followers on social media.
Salman Khan asks how much the gamer ScoutOp aka Tanmay Singh earns, and the answer shocked Salman.

Tanmay Singh, popularly known as ScoutOP, is one of India’s most prominent esports athletes and gaming content creators. He began his professional esports career in 2018 and went on to represent teams including Team IND, Orange Rock and Fnatic, becoming one of the recognised faces of India’s mobile gaming community. ScoutOP has also built a massive digital following through gaming streams, videos and vlogs, and is now entering Bigg Boss 20. Ahead of his entry, fellow digital stars including Abhishek Malhan, CarryMinati and Elvish Yadav extended support for the gamer.
ScoutOp aka Tanmay Singh is a well-known esports player and content creator. He has 4.4 million followers.
Pune-based Marathi hip-hop artist Yung DSA, reportedly named Harsh Vijay Machare, is the next contestants to enter the Bigg Boss 20. He is just 22.
Priyanka Chopra shared warm message for legendary Indian boxer MC Mary Kom, whom she famously portrayed in the 2014 biographical film Mary Kom. Salman Khan shared the special video message.

The next contestant to enter the Bigg Boss 20 house is boxing legend Mary Kom. The introduction by host Salman Khan describes the mystery contestant as a six-time world champion, Olympic medallist, Asian Games and Commonwealth Games champion, and a Padma Vibhushan recipient. Mary Kom came with her two sons.
Love Gill has entered the Bigg Boss 20 house. During her entry, Salman Khan asked Love to make a promise to her fans that she would not disappoint them during her time on the show.

Salman Khan introduced the two contenders whose fate is being decided by the audience as part of the “Fans Ka Faisla” twist. During their interaction, Salman brought up their earlier comments about each other and referred to the viral incident involving Rhiya during the CJP protests. Rhiya Ahir recalled how she stood in front of the van, and Love Gill said that if the driver had not stopped, she might not have been there today. Rhiya shared that her purpose had been fulfilled at that moment. Love Gill then pointed out that inside the Bigg Boss house, everyone can fight for their own rights and she is not needed on the house.
Austrian actor and model Rohed Khan is a part of Bigg Boss 20. He is known for his roles in Bade Miyan Chote Miyan, Sarzameen, Tejas, etc.
Considered one of the highest-paid Bhojpuri actresses, Amrapali Dubey is in the Bigg Boss 20 house.
Badshah’s ex-wife Isha Rikhi says that she will not talk about her past in the house, and she wants to move on, and Salman Khan gave the same advice.

Punjabi actor and rapper Badshah’s ex-wife Isha Rikhi is the latest Bigg Boss 20 contestant. Just a few days back, Isha announced her divorce from Badshah; the two had been married for five months. With Bigg Boss, Isha wants people to know her as a person.

Salman Khan warmly welcomed the singer during the Bigg Boss 20 premiere and asked him about his age as he was famous 20 years back. The singer then recalled his earlier encounters with Salman and shared anecdotes from his journey, including his connection with the popular song “Afghan Jalebi” from Phantom. He also spoke about his past interactions with the superstar, making their conversation a nostalgic moment during the grand premiere.
Fame Gurukul winner, singer, and content creator Qazi Touqeer is a part of Salman Khan’s Bigg Boss 20 as a contestant.

Aasif Khan became emotional after meeting Salman Khan during the Bigg Boss 20 premiere and revealed a special connection with the superstar. The actor shared that he had worked as a background dancer alongside Salman in the song “Dhinka Chika” from the 2011 film Ready. Aasif also shared a heartfelt note for his mother, expressing how happy and proud she can be to see that he is now sharing the stage.

Aasif Khan is a familiar face in the digital entertainment space, known for his performances in popular web series such as Paatal Lok, Panchayat and Jamtara. He has also appeared in films including Bhootnii and Kakuda. Apart from acting, Aasif has worked as a casting director and theatre actor.

Aasif Khan is a familiar face in the digital entertainment space, known for his performances in popular web series such as Paatal Lok, Panchayat and Jamtara. He has also appeared in films including Bhootnii and Kakuda. Apart from acting, Aasif has worked as a casting director and theatre actor.

Ahead of the launch of the milestone 20th season of Bigg Boss, Salman Khan and Bigg Boss shared best wishes for the new chapter in their long-running association. During their interaction, Salman reflected on how much has changed over the years, joking that despite all the changes, both he and Bigg Boss have remained “single.”

Kanika Mann has entered the Bigg Boss 20 house as the first contestant of the season. Soon after her entry, Bigg Boss called her into the Confession Room and handed her a special power that could immediately impact the game. She was told that if she dislikes any contestant, she can take anything from that housemate.
Before making her entry in the Bigg Boss house, Salman Khan gave a few situations to the actor and asked for her reactions.
Kanika Mann's role in Naagin 7 as a dragon was loved by his mom, Salma Khan. Salman asks her game plan for Bigg Boss game.

Kanika Mann has been a familiar face on television and OTT since making her acting debut in 2016 with Badho Bahu. She rose to wider popularity with her performance as Guddan in Guddan Tumse Na Ho Paayega, which established her as a popular television actress. In 2022, she participated in Khatron Ke Khiladi 12 and also made her OTT debut with the series Roohaniyat. Kanika continued to stay active on television and was last seen in Naagin 7 this year.

Salman Khan hits the stage in style as Bigg Boss 20 host. The superstar performs some of his memorable songs on the Bigg Boss 20 premiere stage. “O O Jaane Jaana” from Pyaar Kiya To Darna Kya, “Jaanam Samjha Karo” from Jaanam Samjha Karo, “Oh Oh Jane Jaana”, “Hud Hud Dabangg” from Dabangg, “Character Dheela” from Ready, “Hangover” from Kick, “Baby Ko Bass Pasand Hai” from Sultan, “Swag Se Karenge Sabka Swagat” from Tiger Zinda Hai, “Selfie Le Le Re” from Bajrangi Bhaijaan and “Bhai Bhai” from Dabangg 3, and a few more where the songs on which Salman did the hook steps.

Salman Khan compared the Bigg Boss 20 game to a game of chess, highlighting how every move and decision can change the course of the competition. He revealed that this season, contestants will receive the “vardaan of one extra jeena daan”, giving them an additional chance in the game even after facing elimination.

Bigg Boss Telugu is entering its 10th season with Akkineni Nagarjuna returning as the host for the eighth consecutive time. The Kuberaa actor has become synonymous with the Telugu edition of the reality show, having hosted seven seasons so far. According to Variety, Nagarjuna’s remuneration reportedly peaked in 2025, with the superstar commanding nearly Rs 35 crore for an entire season. READ ALL LIVE UPDATES FROM BIGG BOSS TELUGU 1O HERE

Pune-based Marathi hip-hop artist Yung DSA, reportedly named Harsh Vijay Machare, is among the tentative contestants linked to Bigg Boss 20. Hailing from Pune’s underground hip-hop scene, Yung DSA has gained attention for his energetic performance style and Marathi rap tracks, with his viral song “Yeda Yung” helping him build a growing audience

Malayalam superstar Mohanlal is all set to return as the host of Bigg Boss Malayalam 8, marking his eighth consecutive year with the popular reality show. Mohanlal has been the face of the Malayalam edition since its launch in 2018 and has hosted every season so far. According to Variety, the superstar reportedly earns around Rs 30 crore per season for his hosting duties. Despite the hefty remuneration, he is said to shoot for only around 20 days during each season, making his association with the show one of the most lucrative hosting deals in regional television. READ LIVE UPDATES FROM BIGG BOSS MALAYALAM 8 HERE

Kiccha Sudeepa has begun the Bigg Boss Kannada Season 13, marking his 13th consecutive year at the helm of the reality show. Sudeep has been synonymous with the Kannada edition since its inception and has hosted every season so far. According to Variety, the actor reportedly earns close to Rs 20 crore for an entire season, with his remuneration working out to around Rs 2 crore per weekend episode. READ ALL LIVE UPDATES FROM BIGG BOSS KANNADA 13 HERE

Bigg Boss 20 premieres today, with Salman Khan returning as the host for another season of the popular reality show. The grand premiere will stream first on JioHotstar at 9 pm, while television viewers can watch the episode on Colors TV at 10:30 pm.

The next contestant teased in the Bigg Boss 20 promo is expected to be boxing legend Mary Kom. The introduction by host Salman Khan describes the mystery contestant as a six-time world champion, Olympic medallist, Asian Games and Commonwealth Games champion, and a Padma Vibhushan recipient. The grand introduction, calling her “the one and only” from the champions’ corner, has led fans to believe that the sporting icon making her way into the Bigg Boss house is none other than Mary Kom.

Vijay Sethupathi is set to return as the host of Bigg Boss Tamil Season 10, taking charge of the reality show for the third consecutive year which too premieres tonight. He took over the hosting duties from Kamal Haasan in Season 8 and has since become the face of the Tamil edition. According to Filmibeat Tamil, Vijay Sethupathi reportedly charges around Rs 3-4 crore per weekend, with his total season remuneration estimated at Rs 75-80 crore. Before him, Kamal Haasan was reportedly paid around Rs 130 crore for hosting Bigg Boss Tamil Season 7, according to Deccan Chronicle, making him one of the highest-paid television hosts in India. READ ALL THE LATEST UPDATES FROM BIGG BOSS TAMIL 10 HERE

Sourav Ganguly stepped in as the host of Bigg Boss Bangla Season 3, which premiered with a grand opening on August 30, 2026, marking his return to television after a decade. According to an earlier News18 Bangla report, Sourav Ganguly reportedly signed a four-year deal with Star Jalsha worth Rs 125 crore for the reality show. He followed Mithun Chakraborty and Jeet, who had previously hosted the Bengali edition.

According to a report by ABP Marathi, Salman Khan has reportedly been paid a staggering Rs 120 crore for the entire season of Bigg Boss 20. The superstar, who has been associated with the reality show for several years, reportedly started with a fee of around Rs 2.5 crore per episode in the initial seasons. His remuneration is said to have increased significantly over the years, with reports claiming that he earned around Rs 200 crore for Bigg Boss 17 and nearly Rs 250 crore for Bigg Boss 18.

The Bigg Boss 20 house has been designed around the intriguing theme of duality, taking contestants into a surreal, Alice in Wonderland-inspired world filled with unexpected elements. Spread across 10,000 square feet, the house features two mysterious doors, giant snakes, an octopus, a chameleon and several other quirky installations. Designed by Varsha Jain, the house is equipped with 104 cameras to keep a close watch on the contestants. The kitchen, too, gets an unconventional makeover with a food-truck-inspired design. With around 20 contestants expected to enter the house, the entire setup revolves around the idea of two sides, two choices and multiple possibilities. Adding another layer of mystery is Room No. 20, whose purpose and details have been kept under wraps, making it one of the biggest talking points of the new season. READ MORE

Going by the promo videos, Rhiya Ahir -- who became the face of CJP protest -- and Punjabi model Love Gill have made an appearance on Bigg Boss 20 as part of a special “Fans Ka Faisla” twist, where viewers will decide which of the two gets a confirmed spot inside the house. Rhiya shot to national attention after a video showed her standing in front of a Mumbai Police van during a student protest, while her possible reality TV entry later sparked both support and criticism online. In an exclusive interview to SCREEN, Rhiya said she had second thoughts about entering the Salman Khan show, but made up her mind after speaking to her family. Read her interview here. READ MORE

After an eight-month wait, Salman Khan is all set to return as the host of Bigg Boss 20, bringing back the drama, entertainment and his much-awaited Weekend Ka Vaar sessions. The grand premiere takes place tonight, with the reality show streaming first on JioHotstar at 9 pm, followed by its television telecast on Colors TV at 10:30 pm.

A new Bigg Boss 20 promo features a Punjabi actor introducing herself before getting emotional while opening up about heartbreak, separation, and the pain of losing someone she once trusted. The mystery around her identity has sparked strong speculation among fans, with many guessing that the actor could be Isha Rikhi, especially given her recent separation from rapper Badshah. The promo does not explicitly reveal her name, but the emotional context has led viewers to connect the mystery contestant with Isha. Her possible entry has further intensified curiosity about what she may reveal about her personal journey inside the Bigg Boss 20 house.

The mystery around her identity has sparked strong speculation among fans, with many guessing that the actor could be Isha Rikhi, especially given her recent separation from rapper Badshah. The promo does not explicitly reveal her name, but the emotional context has led viewers to connect the mystery contestant with Isha. Her possible entry has further intensified curiosity about what she may reveal about her personal journey inside the Bigg Boss 20 house.

Salman Khan, who is returning as the host of Bigg Boss 20, appeared visibly irritated with the paparazzi while shooting for the upcoming season. In a video from the sets, the actor, dressed in a distinctive cowboy-inspired look, asked photographers to maintain a proper distance from the stage. When the paps continued asking him to pose for more pictures and called addressed him as 'Baba idhar', Salman reacted, saying, “Baba. Yeh mera kaam nahi hai baba. Uditi Singh has gained attention after she appeared to be the mystery woman featured in Bigg Boss's latest promo. Actor and model Uditi Singh is Karan Wahi’s ex-girlfriend.

Punjabi actor Isha Rikhi is expected to enter Bigg Boss 20 amid intense public interest following her recent separation from rapper Badshah. The couple announced their split on September 1 after keeping their relationship largely private. Rikhi has since urged people to rely only on information shared through her official channels and not believe rumours.

Mahhi Vij, known for her memorable roles in Laagi Tujhse Lagan and Balika Vadhu, is expected to enter Salman Khan-hosted show Bigg Boss Season 20. A glimpes of Mahhi’s power-packed performance was unveiled by the makers today.

Tanmay Singh, popularly known as ScoutOP, is one of India’s most prominent esports athletes and gaming content creators. He began his professional esports career in 2018 and went on to represent teams including Team IND, Orange Rock and Fnatic, becoming one of the recognised faces of India’s mobile gaming community. ScoutOP has also built a massive digital following through gaming streams, videos and vlogs, and is now entering Bigg Boss 20. Ahead of his entry, fellow digital stars including Abhishek Malhan, CarryMinati and Elvish Yadav extended support for the gamer.

Bhojpuri star Dinesh Lal Yadav, popularly known as Nirahua, made an appearance on Bigg Boss 20, sparking a flurry of reactions and memes on social media. His presence also fuelled speculation among fans about Amrapali Dubey potentially entering the reality show.

Manoj Tiwari’s daughter Rhiti Tiwari is all set to enter Bigg Boss 20 as a contestant. In a new promo, Manoj makes a special appearance to drop his daughter off, while Salman Khan welcomes Rhiti with his trademark humour. The promo also references Manoj’s memorable Bigg Boss 4 stint. Giving her advice regarding the fights that happen inside the house, Salman quips, "Don't fight over eggs."
Host Salman Khan is all set to kick off Bigg Boss 20 in style as he performs 20 of his most iconic dance steps right at the start of the episode.
The season's core theme is "Tathastu" (teased as "Tathas-two" or "Vardaan"), which centers around the concept of duality, illusions, and getting a special blessing or second chance.
Bigg Boss 20 premieres today with Salman Khan returning as the host. The grand premiere will stream first on JioHotstar at 9 pm, while viewers can also watch it on Colors TV at 10:30 pm.
